name: swarm-ui
description: The swarm UI route scaffold, installed into an existing Next.js App Router app (the UI is the product): Progress, News, Targets, Results, Versions, Ideas buried, Fleet, Sessions, Rallypoint, Board, Messages, How it works, Protocol, Concepts, Skills. Read-only. Generates a project-owned app/swarm/swarm.config.ts.

files.content: import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react"; import type { NavIconName, SwarmNavItem, SwarmTarget } from "../_lib/config-types"; /** * Line icons for the nav, drawn on a 24px grid with a 1.75px stroke. Each has * a name a `swarm.config.ts` nav item can pick with `icon`; the scaffold's own * routes are mapped to theirs by href in `routeIcons` below. */ const icons: Record = { // The scaffold's own routes. pulse: , news: ( <> ), target: ( <> ), clipboard: ( <> ), branch: ( <> ), grave: ( <> ), people: ( <> ), robot: ( <> ), merge: ( <> ), list: ( <> ), chat: ( <> ), compass: ( <> ), flow: ( <> ), grid: ( <> ), book: , // For the routes a project adds. brush: ( <> ), inbox: ( <> ), check: ( <> ), document: ( <> ), card: ( <> ), mail: ( <> ), chart: ( <> ), settings: ( <> ), globe: ( <> ), home: ( <> ), page: ( <> ), }; /** The icon each scaffold route gets when its nav item names none. */ const routeIcons: Record = { "/swarm": "pulse", "/swarm/news": "news", "/swarm/targets": "target", "/swarm/results": "clipboard", "/swarm/versions": "branch", "/swarm/buried": "grave", "/swarm/fleet": "people", "/swarm/sessions": "robot", "/swarm/rallypoint": "merge", "/swarm/board": "list", "/swarm/messages": "chat", "/swarm/how-it-works": "compass", "/swarm/protocol": "flow", "/swarm/concepts": "grid", "/swarm/skills": "book", }; const isIconName = (name: unknown): name is NavIconName => typeof name === "string" && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(icons, name); /** * Which icon a nav item gets, in this order: the item's own `icon`; the * scaffold route's icon for its href; `target` for a single target's page * (`/swarm/targets/`); `page` for any other path in the app. Only an href * that is not a path, such as an external link, falls back to a dot. * * A target page gets the line icon rather than its `TargetMark`: the mark is a * 22px filled tile, which sits off the 18px icon column of the sections above, * and the targets list at the foot of the nav already shows each mark. */ export function navIconName(item: Pick): NavIconName | null { if (isIconName(item.icon)) return item.icon; const route = routeIcons[item.href]; if (route) return route; if (item.href.startsWith("/swarm/targets/")) return "target"; if (item.href.startsWith("/")) return "page"; return null; } export function NavIcon({ item }: { item: Pick }) { const name = navIconName(item); return ( ); } export function ArrowIcon({ out }: { out?: boolean }) { return ( ); } /** The style that carries a target's colour into its mark, card and chart. */ export function targetStyle(target: Pick): CSSProperties { return { "--rp-target": target.color } as CSSProperties; } /** * A target's mark: a tinted tile with the first letter of its name. Always * printed beside the name, so the colour never carries meaning alone. */ export function TargetMark({ target, size = "m" }: { target: SwarmTarget; size?: "s" | "m" | "l" }) { const letter = Array.from(target.name.trim() || target.id)[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "·"; return ( {letter} ); }
